Thank you for installing VideoNotes!

VideoNotes is a simple extension for saving videos and notes while you browse, without unnecessary complexity or data collection.

🔒 Privacy First

VideoNotes was designed following a Privacy First approach. Your data and notes remain under your control.

✨ Simple by design

VideoNotes does one thing and does it simply: it lets you save videos and take notes while watching them. No accounts, no unnecessary features.

If you find the extension useful and would like to support the project, every contribution is greatly appreciated ❤️
